keyFindings.description: While the gone-pod sweep waits for the claims to record the new pod, turns and answers in the new pod change the old pod's round: an Envoy turn takes an answer back and the issue is told work was lost when every worker had answered (also after a ReplacePod timeout), and a re-sent ask answered from a fresh disk hides real lost work. Reproduced (three cases).

A held round end is dropped only for a different round id; a round reopened over the same pod keeps it, and the sweep posts no PodUpdateOpen in completePodUpdate's working branch, so the worker is told to carry on while the drift stands. Reproduced at both levels.
After a restart askFirst treats the task an answered round holds as possibly sent; the first unrelated turn confirms it and its end retires it unsent. Reproduced.
The late notice, built from the unmasked read, can have an empty waiting list; the store refuses it every tick. Reproduced.
A suspended Sandbox's terminating pod is read as live; under a rollback in that window the round ends as not replaced and the carry-on goes out over a pod being deleted.
A worker that read the ask but no longer stands answered is not released when the drift clears.
noPluginInstall reads only the backend, so a tmux Claude Code pane is also never relaunched for its contract, although its plugin directory would be reread on relaunch.
